recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is recommended for FHIR-7883 unless a future work group decision changes the List.encounter semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-7883 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core List change request from the DSTU1 ballot asking to add encounter : Encounter [0..1] because lists such as medication reconciliation are created in the context of an encounter. The approved resolution was to add encounter : Encounter [0..1] : the encounter that is the context in which this list was created.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied by git commit f6381da8b85b30ea9bf2c8053906672ce7d84a09, whose subject is "#7883 - add List.encounter + list.$find operation". That commit added List.encounter as a 0..1 Reference(Encounter) with the approved definition to the then-authoritative List spreadsheet and added the encounter search parameter row. Later source rework commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 carried the element forward into source/list/structuredefinition-List.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini has List as an active resource, so source/list/structuredefinition-List.xml and source/list/bundle-List-search-params.xml are in current build scope. Current source still defines List.encounter as 0..1 Reference(Encounter), with short text "Context in which list created" and definition "The encounter that is the context in which this list was created." Corrected Zulip and Confluence searches for FHIR-7883 with List/encounter found no directly relevant or conflicting community records.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current List StructureDefinition already contains the element requested by FHIR-7883, and the companion List encounter search parameter remains present.
